name: TWO_WAY_ARROWS_YELLOW_LONG

t2-24_arrow.desc: upward arrow 175 wide x 376 high: head 160 high with R10 tips (barb offset 16), tapered shaft 50 at head to 66 at foot

t2-24_arrow_down.desc: downward arrow 175 wide x 376 high (the up arrow inverted), traced from its own box on the drawing

notes: Up arrow at x 205, down arrow at x 520 (205+175+140); both 112 from top and bottom. Shaft is tapered (50/66) so not drawn as a polygon. The down arrow is traced from its own box (a second element with the same id would re-trace and overwrite the up arrow). Arrow drawn as an exact polygon from the inset dimensions (tip and barb radii inscribed so the outline reaches the stated extremes; shaft tapers from the head junction to the tail as dimensioned).
